question: Does the text-to-speech API support streaming responses?
ground_truth: To stream audio in real-time, use the POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/stream endpoint instead of the regular convert endpoint. This endpoint returns audio as a text/event-stream (binary streaming data) rather than waiting for the complete file. You can also use the optimize_streaming_latency query parameter with values 0-4 to control latency optimization: 0 = default (no optimization), 1 = normal (~50% latency improvement), 2 = strong (~75% improvement), 3 = max optimization, 4 = max optimization with text normalizer disabled for best latency but potential mispronunciation of numbers/dates.
